# Hermes Labs CVSS Consistency

> Fixture replay and offline checker for CVSS 3.0/3.1 score/vector consistency in local CVE 5.x JSON records, published as the code artifact behind one Hermes Labs case study.

This is a case-study repository, not a general-purpose product. It packages the checker used to reproduce one specific CISA Vulnrichment correction (CVE-2026-14216) and ships the CLI that performs the underlying score/vector comparison.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): what the checker does, how to replay the correction, exit codes, and fixture provenance
- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): citation metadata
- [Case study](https://hermes-labs.ai/case-studies/cisa-vulnrichment-score-consistency): the narrative write-up this repo supports

## Optional
- [fixtures/provenance.json](fixtures/provenance.json): source repositories, commits, retrieval date, and hashes for the shipped fixtures
- [archive/README.md](archive/README.md): the archived historical scanner, its exact hash, and its scope

## What this does NOT do
- It does not fetch data over the network or test a live target; it is offline and read-only.
- It does not reproduce the original time-bounded corpus audit, general CVE coverage, or exploitation behavior — only the one fixture pair.
- It is not a general vulnerability-data-quality product; it is the reproducible artifact for a single documented case.

## Maturity
Version 0.1.0. Small, single-purpose, MIT licensed. No stability guarantees beyond what CITATION.cff and the README state.

## About Hermes Labs

Hermes Labs is an independent AI-reliability lab. More at [hermes-labs.ai](https://hermes-labs.ai).
